verse_text_english: In the name of God, Most Gracious, Most Merciful
verse_text_arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: bis'mi l-lahi l-raḥmāni l-raḥīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم

verse_text_english: The blowing winds.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verse_text_transliterated: wal-dhāriyāti dharwa
verse_text_arabic_clean: والذريت ذروا

verse_text_english: Bearing rain.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالحملت وقرا

verse_text_english: Bringing provisions.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-jāriyāti yus'ra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالجريت يسرا

verse_text_english: Distributing them as commanded.
verse_text_arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verse_text_transliterated: fal-muqasimāti amra
verse_text_arabic_clean: فالمقسمت أمرا

verse_text_english: What is promised to you will surely come to pass.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verse_text_transliterated: innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqu
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنما توعدون لصادق

verse_text_english: The Day of Judgment is inevitable. 0 2405 r
verse_text_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verse_text_transliterated: wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿu
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإن الدين لوقع

verse_text_english: Despite the perfectly created sky.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuk
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء ذات الحبك

verse_text_english: You continue to dispute the truth.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verse_text_transliterated: innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifi
verse_text_arabic_clean: إنكم لفى قول مختلف

verse_text_english: Deviating therefrom are the deviators.
verse_text_arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verse_text_transliterated: yu'faku ʿanhu man ufik
verse_text_arabic_clean: يؤفك عنه من أفك

verse_text_english: Woe to the falsifiers.
verse_text_arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qutila l-kharāṣūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قتل الخرصون

verse_text_english: In their blundering, they are totally heedless.
verse_text_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: الذين هم فى غمرة ساهون

verse_text_english: They question the Day of Judgment.
verse_text_arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verse_text_transliterated: yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يسـٔلون أيان يوم الدين

verse_text_english: The day they are presented to the fire.
verse_text_arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: يوم هم على النار يفتنون

verse_text_english: Taste the retribution; this what you used to challenge.
verse_text_arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذى كنتم به تستعجلون

verse_text_english: The righteous have deserved gardens and springs.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūni
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن المتقين فى جنت وعيون

verse_text_english: They receive their Lord’s rewards, for they used to be pious.
verse_text_arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ءاخذين ما ءاتىهم ربهم إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين

verse_text_english: Rarely did they sleep the whole night
verse_text_arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: كانوا قليلا من اليل ما يهجعون

verse_text_english: At dawn, they prayed for forgiveness.
verse_text_arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون

verse_text_english: A portion of their money was set aside for the beggar and the needy.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى أمولهم حق للسائل والمحروم

verse_text_english: The earth is full of signs for those who are certain.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى الأرض ءايت للموقنين

verse_text_english: And within yourselves; can you see?
verse_text_arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى أنفسكم أفلا تبصرون

verse_text_english: In the heaven is your provision, and everything that is promised to you.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى السماء رزقكم وما توعدون

verse_text_english: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, this is as true as the fact that you speak.
verse_text_arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فورب السماء والأرض إنه لحق مثل ما أنكم تنطقون

verse_text_english: Have you noted the history of Abraham’s honorable guests? 521
verse_text_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: هل أتىك حديث ضيف إبرهيم المكرمين

verse_text_english: They visited him, saying, “Peace.” He said, “Peace to you, strangers!”
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلما قال سلم قوم منكرون

verse_text_english: He asked his family to prepare a fat calf.
verse_text_arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: فراغ إلى أهله فجاء بعجل سمين

verse_text_english: When he offered it to them, he remarked, “Do you not eat?”
verse_text_arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فقربه إليهم قال ألا تأكلون

verse_text_english: He harbored fear of them. They said, “Have no fear,” and they gave good news of a knowledgeable son.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلم عليم

verse_text_english: His wife was astonished. Noting her wrinkled face: “I am a sterile old woman.”
verse_text_arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأقبلت امرأته فى صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم

verse_text_english: They said, “Thus said your Lord. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.” 0 2405 522
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا كذلك قال ربك إنه هو الحكيم العليم

verse_text_english: He said, “What are you up to, O messengers?”
verse_text_arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون

verse_text_english: They said, “We have been dispatched to criminal people.
verse_text_arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين

verse_text_english: “We will shower them with rocks of clay.
verse_text_arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين

verse_text_english: “Marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”
verse_text_arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين

verse_text_english: We then delivered all the believers.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأخرجنا من كان فيها من المؤمنين

verse_text_english: We did not find in it except one house of Muslims.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين

verse_text_english: We set it up as a lesson for those who fear the painful retribution.
verse_text_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وتركنا فيها ءاية للذين يخافون العذاب الأليم

verse_text_english: In Moses (there is a lesson). We sent him to Pharaoh with manifest signs.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى موسى إذ أرسلنه إلى فرعون بسلطن مبين

verse_text_english: But he turned away, in arrogance, and said, “Magician, or crazy.”
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتولى بركنه وقال سحر أو مجنون

verse_text_english: Consequently, we punished him and his troops. the sea, and he is the one to blame.
verse_text_arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmu
verse_text_arabic_clean: فأخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم فى اليم وهو مليم

verse_text_english: In ‘Aad (there is a lesson). We sent upon them disastrous wind.
verse_text_arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى عاد إذ أرسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم

verse_text_english: Anything that it came upon was utterly destroyed.
verse_text_arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verse_text_transliterated: mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīm
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما تذر من شىء أتت عليه إلا جعلته كالرميم

verse_text_english: In Thamoud (there is a lesson).
verse_text_arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verse_text_transliterated: wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīni
verse_text_arabic_clean: وفى ثمود إذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتى حين

verse_text_english: They rebelled against the command of their Lord. lightning struck them as they looked.
verse_text_arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فعتوا عن أمر ربهم فأخذتهم الصعقة وهم ينظرون

verse_text_english: They could never get up, nor were they helped.
verse_text_arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فما استطعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين

verse_text_english: And the people of Noah before that; they were wicked people. “Expansion of the Universe Theory” Confirmed
verse_text_arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَٰسِقِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وقوم نوح من قبل إنهم كانوا قوما فسقين

verse_text_english: We constructed the sky with our hands, and we will continue to expand it.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والسماء بنينها بأييد وإنا لموسعون

verse_text_english: And we made the earth habitable; a perfect design.
verse_text_arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: والأرض فرشنها فنعم المهدون

verse_text_english: We created a pair (male and female) of everything, that you may take heed.
verse_text_arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ومن كل شىء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون

verse_text_english: You shall escape to GOD. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner.
verse_text_arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ففروا إلى الله إنى لكم منه نذير مبين

verse_text_english: Do not set up besides GOD any other god. I am sent by Him to you as a manifest warner. 2 2407 The Winds (Al-Dhaareyaat) 51:52-60 & Mt. 523
verse_text_arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verse_text_transliterated: walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: ولا تجعلوا مع الله إلها ءاخر إنى لكم منه نذير مبين

verse_text_english: Consistently, when a messenger went to the previous generations, they said, “Magician,” or, “Crazy.”
verse_text_arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verse_text_transliterated: kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnu
verse_text_arabic_clean: كذلك ما أتى الذين من قبلهم من رسول إلا قالوا ساحر أو مجنون

verse_text_english: Did they make an agreement with each other? Indeed, they are transgressors.
verse_text_arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: أتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون

verse_text_english: You may disregard them; you cannot be blamed.
verse_text_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verse_text_transliterated: fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmi
verse_text_arabic_clean: فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم

verse_text_english: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers. 56.1 did not create the jinns and the humans except to worship Me alone. 57.1 need no provisions from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
verse_text_arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verse_text_transliterated: wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين

verse_text_english: I did not create the jinns and the humans except to worship Me alone.
verse_text_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون

verse_text_english: I need no provisions from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
verse_text_arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: ما أريد منهم من رزق وما أريد أن يطعمون

verse_text_english: GOD is the Provider, the Possessor of all power, the Supreme.
verse_text_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verse_text_transliterated: inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين

verse_text_english: The transgressors have incurred the same fate as their previous counter­ parts; they should not challenge.
verse_text_arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verse_text_transliterated: fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فإن للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب أصحبهم فلا يستعجلون

verse_text_english: Woe to those who disbelieved from the day that is awaiting them. \
verse_text_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verse_text_transliterated: fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذى يوعدون
